summary: IDS feed s173_triple is degraded: 25.4% duplicates, 100% VLAN tags stripped (VLANs 10,20 missing), and 1.3% TCP gaps indicating packet drops. IDS requires full payload and both directions with VLAN awareness - duplicates waste capacity and trigger duplicate alerts, missing VLANs blind VLAN-specific detection, and gaps break stream reassembly.

findings.root_cause: Traffic from same link is being aggregated from multiple TAP/SPAN sources or both sides of a link without packet broker deduplication. 1130 of 4450 packets (25.4%) are duplicates, well above 5% threshold.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS wastes cycles processing same packet twice, inflates event counts, causes duplicate alerts, and risks missing real attacks due to cache/state exhaustion; needs_full_payload analysis is degraded.

recommended_fix.why: Enable broker deduplication to drop duplicate packets before IDS. 25% duplicates is far above tolerance and directly reduces detection capacity.

findings.root_cause: Packet broker or SPAN is stripping 802.1Q tags. 100% of packets are untagged and required VLANs 10 and 20 never appear, indicating 'strip VLAN' or 'remove tag on egress' is enabled on broker egress toward IDS.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS cannot apply VLAN-aware policies or detect lateral movement/segmentation violations for VLANs 10,20. All VLAN-based detection and filtering for this IDS is blind.

recommended_fix.why: Configure broker egress to preserve 802.1Q tags and forward VLANs 10,20 to IDS so it can enforce VLAN-specific rules.

findings.root_cause: Visibility path is dropping packets - 55 of 4349 TCP packets (1.3%) show gaps/retransmissions above 1% threshold. Likely broker egress buffer drops/microbursts or SPAN oversubscription, not tool overload (tool_overload healthy). Duplicates at 25% may be exacerbating bursts.
findings.impact_on_tool: IDS stream reassembly fails with missing segments; needs_full_payload and needs_both_directions true, so dropped packets cause missed exploits, incomplete file extraction, and false negatives.

recommended_fix.why: Distribute load and add buffering via load-balanced IDS pool or fix SPAN oversubscription; also enable dedup first to reduce burst load causing drops.
